name: ArenaScrollerBehaviour
description: Whether a scrolled row settles on an item or wherever it was left. Two words and not a boolean, because the pair is a decision about how the row reads and a boolean would name only one half of it. Snap says the row is a sequence of things and lands on one. Flow says the row is a strip and lands anywhere. Neither moves on its own, so nothing here answers prefers-reduced-motion, and the component is not named for a marquee.
